# deed_label_rule (Resource)

A Deed label rule: labels (such as `group = "github"`) added to the entities of a project that the rule's `match` selects — entities other sources own, without declaring them. Rules apply **below every source** (a source's own label for the same key wins) and never keep an entity alive. Creating, changing or destroying a rule re-applies the project's rules before the apply finishes. Requires Deed 0.7.0 or later and a project `admin` token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Everything the GitHub connector imports belongs to the "github" group.
resource "deed_label_rule" "github" {
  project = "infra"
  name    = "github"
  match   = { sources = ["github"] }
  labels  = { group = "github" }
}

# DNS from any state: records, zones and domains.
resource "deed_label_rule" "dns" {
  project = "infra"
  name    = "dns"
  match   = { kinds = ["dns_*", "domain"] }
  labels  = { group = "dns" }
}

# One state holds both DNS records and Cloudflare rulesets: tell them apart by the Terraform resource type label.
resource "deed_label_rule" "cloudflare" {
  project     = "infra"
  name        = "cloudflare-rulesets"
  description = "Rulesets of the Cloudflare stacks"
  match = {
    sources = ["tf-cloudflare-*"]
    labels  = { "terraform/type" = "cloudflare_ruleset" }
  }
  labels = { group = "cloudflare" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `labels` (Map of String) Labels to add (at most 32; values 1–256 bytes). A source's own label for the same key wins.
- `name` (String) Unique name in the project (lowercase slug).
- `project` (String) Project name or ID. Changing it forces a new resource (the same project by name or ID does not).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `match` (Attributes) The entities the rule applies to: every given criterion must match; omit `match` for every entity of the project. Kinds, source names and label values are globs (`*`, `?`, `[…]`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--match))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Label rule ID (`lbr_…`).
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`prj_…`).

<a id="nestedatt--match"></a>
### Nested Schema for `match`

Optional:

- `kinds` (Set of String) Entity kinds (any may match), e.g. `["dns_*", "domain"]`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels the entity's sources set (all must match; values may be globs), e.g. `{ "terraform/type" = "cloudflare_ruleset" }`. Labels added by other rules are not matched.
- `sources` (Set of String) Names of sources that describe the entity (any may match), e.g. `["tf-cloudflare-*"]`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project>/<rule name or ID>
terraform import deed_label_rule.github infra/github
```
